title: os-process-placement
summary: Place and configure inference/training processes at the OS level before measuring or optimizing: check then pin CPU affinity to the accelerator-local NUMA node (taskset/numactl), keep affinity constant across measurement rounds, set thread-count environment variables (OMP_NUM_THREADS, OMP_PROC_BIND, CPU_AFFINITY_CONF) per scenario, run a device-busy preflight (npu-smi/nvidia-smi usages, graceful-then-force PID cleanup), and structure environment checks as ERROR vs WARNING with per-failure remediation. Use before any performance measurement on shared multi-socket or multi-tenant hosts. Does not cover cgroups, cpuset, isolcpus, or scheduler priorities — no source evidence for those.
